en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a rocky landscape with a prominent signpost in the foreground, placed beside a large stone. In the background, there are distant hills or mountains. The sign on the post appears to have writing in Greek. There is handwritten text on the left and bottom edges, and a postage stamp is affixed in the top right corner. At the bottom, printed text in French identifies the location as 'Grèce. Aedipsos. Source de la Princesse Marie.'
